answer: Seed hidden canary tasks: each epoch 6% of jobs carry answers the network already knows, and nobody can tell which. An agent that misses a canary loses 2 POA of a 20 POA bond. A farm of clones running one script, as cheap as copper wire, repeats the same wrong answers, leaving a dune of identical errors that merges them into one cluster with split voting weight, so every extra fake adds a full bond plus slashes. A whisper of honest noise costs little. Canary keys are published afterward for audit.
